name: drupal/audit_chain
description: Tamper-evident, hash-chained audit logging for any Drupal module — optional HMAC signing, at-rest encryption, prefix seal for historical segments, and independent verification.

suggest.drupal/mcp_sentinel: Required only by the Audit Chain MCP submodule (audit_chain_mcp): ^2.22. Not a dev requirement: MCP Sentinel requires this module, and a pipeline that installed it would fetch a second copy.
suggest.drupal/tool: Required only by the Audit Chain MCP submodule (audit_chain_mcp): ^1.0.0-beta8.
suggest.drupal/charts: Optional: upgrades the keyed-vs-unkeyed SVG on Reports → Audit Chain to an interactive chart (install a library submodule such as charts_chartjs). The page keeps the SVG fallback when Charts is absent or has no library.
